fields.Name: T15 - AI Application Prompt Management
fields.Description: Verifies the AI Prompts section is reachable and renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Use the application switcher dropdown to open the AI app, then the Prompts section. Verify the Prompts management view renders. If the prompts list is populated, open a prompt to view its detail. NOTE: the prompts list may intermittently show an 'Error loading prompts' / 'No prompts found' state due to a known data-loading issue — if so, verifying that the Prompts SECTION itself renders (without a crash) is acceptable. Success = the Prompts section is reachable and renders (a prompt detail opened OR the section rendered with its current state); a crash or blank white screen is a fail. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI Prompts section was reached and rendered
A prompt detail opened OR the Prompts list rendered (even if showing the known empty/error state)
No crash, raw error stack, or blank white screen
